conditions: The discharge pipe is sloped downwards in the direction of leaving the pump
It is necessary to stop backflow of unclean water
assertions.applicability: Vertical multistage centrifugal pump installation with specified features
assertions.evidence_text:
If your installation is characterized by one of
following features, please install one vacuum
valve near the pump.
● The discharge pipe is sloped downwards
in the direction of leaving the pump.
● Siphonage may occur.
● It is necessary to stop backflow of unclean
water.
